mechanism: The batch size is one row larger than the bind limit allows, so every full batch binds len(columns) parameters more than MAX_BIND_PARAMS and SQLite raises OperationalError('too many SQL variables') on any write large enough to fill a batch.
accepted_finding_forms: _batches adds one to the rows-per-batch, so a full batch exceeds the 999 bound-parameter limit
off-by-one in the batch size: MAX_BIND_PARAMS // len(columns) + 1 rows bind more than MAX_BIND_PARAMS parameters
the +1 in per_batch makes each statement one row too big and SQLite will reject it with 'too many SQL variables'
batch sizing is wrong -- it over-counts by one row, defeating the very limit the batching was added to respect
the new batching still exceeds the parameter cap because per_batch is computed as floor(limit/cols)+1
